result.title: FrontVeg V2: A Training-Free Software Framework for Foreground-Aware Zero-Shot Plant Trait Segmentation in High-Resolution Images of Trellised Crops
result.summary: FrontVeg V2 is an open-source, training-free software framework for foregroundaware zero-shot segmentation of plant traits in high-resolution images of trellised crops. The pipeline combines monocular depth estimation, automatic foreground extraction using Valley-Aware Depth Thresholding, tiled zero-shot segmentation, Graph-Based Mask Assembly, and geometry-aware fusion. This design enables plant organs and disease symptoms to be segmented while reducing detections arising from neighboring vegetation rows. The current implementation integrates Depth Anything V2 (DAV2) and SAM3 and can be used through both command-line batch processing and a Napari graphical interface. FrontVeg V2 provides a reusable framework for multi-crop, multi-trait digital phenotyping without task-specific model retraining.

AI.brief_summary: FrontVeg V2 是一个免训练的开源软件框架，结合单目深度估计与零样本分割（DAV2、SAM3），在棚架作物高分辨率图像中实现前景感知的植物器官与病害症状分割。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于农业表型分割的工程流水线，处理的是像素级掩码输出，未涉及 VLM 内部推理状态、latent 表示、证据获取或停止决策，与 LVR 主线缺少实质联系。
